task: Why are complaints up this week?
answer:
The complaints went through Hub W2.

- "Switch west region deliveries to Courier Y to cut cost" assumed Courier Y delivers at least 90% on time through Hub W2; this week it is 77%. At the same time "Run the Festive Flash Sale (40% off kitchen) in the west" was running: campaign FEST40 ran during the window; 58% of parcels through Hub W2 in the window used its coupon.
- "Promise 2-day delivery to west customers" assumed West deliveries via Hub W2 are 85% on time; this week it is 77%. At the same time "Run the Festive Flash Sale (40% off kitchen) in the west" was running: campaign FEST40 ran during the window; 58% of parcels through Hub W2 in the window used its coupon.
- "Run the Festive Flash Sale (40% off kitchen) in the west" assumed Hubs can handle the sale volume within daily capacity; this week it is 157%.
- "Run the Winter Sale (25% off home) in the west" assumed Hub W2 can carry the Winter Sale volume; this week it is 157%. At the same time "Run the Festive Flash Sale (40% off kitchen) in the west" was running: campaign FEST40 ran during the window; 58% of parcels through Hub W2 in the window used its coupon.
